content: Naamath tami Zophar ni a pathung e teh,

content.text: Hettelae lawk kapap e heh pathung laipalah ao thai han namaw,
Lawk moikapap ka dei e pueng ni maw kayonhoehe la o awh han.
Na dei e lawk hrawnghrang ni, tami a roum sak thai han namaw,
Tami na panuikhai nah buet touh ni hai yue mahoeh namaw.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ka yuemnae teh a thoung.
Na mithmu vah kathoung telah na ti.
Hateiteh, oe Cathut ni na dei pouh seh,
nang kâtaran lahoi pahni ang naseh.
Ama ni lungangnae arulawk hah na hmu sak yawkaw han,
bangkongtetpawiteh, na lungangnae alet hni touh apap.
Hatdawkvah na payonpakai e dawk hoi kayounhnawn lah Cathut ni a sak tie panuek.
Kadungpoung e Cathut e hno hah na pakhingpalang thai na maw,
Athakasaipounge coungnae hah
na tawng teh koung na hmuthai maw.
Kalvan hlak hai a rasang teh, nang ni bangmaw na sak thai,
Phuennaw hlak hai hoe adung teh, nang ni bangmaw na panue.
A bangnuenae teh, talai hlak hai asaw.
Tuipui hlak hai hoe akaw.
A man teh thongim dawk paung hoi lawkceng hanelah pâkhueng pawiteh,
apinimaw ahni teh a rungngang thai han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, huenghai ao a e hah a panue,
thoe sak e hai a hmu.
Ama ni pouk laipalah maw ao han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, kahrawng e laca patetlah tami a khe torei teh,
tamipathu teh a lungang han.
Na lungthin hah kârakueng nateh
Cathut koe na kut dâw haw.
Na kut dawk na payonpakai e awm boipawiteh, ahlanae koe tâkhawng haw.
Kathoute hah na im dawk awm hanh seh.
Hottelah tounnae awm laipalah, na minhmai hah a kamnue han doeh.
Kacakcalah na o vaiteh, na taket mahoeh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, na rucatnae hah na pahnim vaiteh,
poun ka lawng e tui patetlah pahnim hanh.
Na hringnae teh kanîthun e hlak hai hoe a ang han,
a hmonae hah amom patetlah ao han.
Karoumcalah na o han,
bangkongtetpawiteh, ngaihawinae ao.
Na tengpam e hno na sung nakunghai karoumcalah na kâhat han.
Na i vaiteh, apinihai tâsuenae na poe mahoeh,
tami moikapap ni nang koe a kâhei awh han.
Hateiteh, tamikathoutnaw e mit teh, dawn vaiteh,
hlout awh mahoeh.
A ngaihawi awh e hringnae teh a sung awh han telah a ti.
